title: Fun mix, small box for price
text: My first box contained a few items from Indonesia. It was really fun to see and taste products I’ve never seen before. For the price, it was a little disappointing to receive what likely would have cost about $2, but I recognize that this is a novelty and I’m paying for an experience. I will probably allow the next box to auto ship and determine at that time whether it’s worth continuing with this subscription.
label: neutral
